stages.name: Run
captions: The transactor runs a register program against our peripheral with its early-response bug switched on. The checker watches the bus wires and has armed a capture on its first violation.

stages.name: Capture
captions: The capture from the board, replayed cycle by cycle around the trigger.

stages.name: Verdict
captions: The checker names the rule broken: B_EARLY, a write response raised before its write data had arrived. AMD's AXI Protocol Checker on the same bus also flagged this run.

wave.alt: A waveform captured on the board: after the address handshake the peripheral raises BVALID, its write response, before any write data; the checker's B_EARLY rule goes high in that cycle and the write data arrives afterwards.
